title: Credit Balance Refund Requests on Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts
content:
## Rule

On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, a refund request asks for the credit balance on an employer's tax account to be paid out instead of being applied to the next quarter due.

The refundable amount is worked out only after the ledger carries an estimated assessment for every quarter whose report is still unfiled at least the class's estimated assessment days after its due date.

Put the other way: while the ledger of the account lacks an estimated assessment for any quarter whose report is still unfiled at least the class's estimated assessment days after its due date, the refundable amount is not yet worked out.

- **The payment cited.** The request cites the payment that created the credit: where the credit arose from contributions credited back to a quarter, it is the last contribution payment received for that quarter.
- **Issue of the refund.** An approved refund is issued within the refund processing business days and recorded against the refund request.

## Lodging the request: `request_credit_refund_f44db5b5`

**Capability.** One call lodges the employer's own request to have the credit balance on its unemployment insurance tax account paid out as a refund. It records one refund request in the employer's name on the account, dated the day of the call, asking for the amount given and citing the payment that created the credit. The request is received for processing: nothing is paid by this call, the credit remains on the account while the request is open, and the refund is issued against it. The employer can see the request and its status in its online account.

**How it is invoked.** `request_credit_refund_f44db5b5` is the employer's own tool. The representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the employer — the customer themselves — runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `employer_account_id` | The reference number of the employer's unemployment insurance tax account, as returned by the employer account lookup | Identifier |
| `credit_payment_entry_id` | The reference number of the balance-history entry of the payment that created the credit, as shown in the account's balance history | Identifier |
| `requested_amount` | The refund amount asked for | US dollars with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when no amount; passed already rounded to the cent and recorded exactly as given |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence that starts with "Refund request received" and states the request reference (an opaque reference beginning with "acr_"), the amount asked for in USD with 2 decimal places, the cited payment entry and the request status "received". That sentence means the request is on the account awaiting the refund.

## Basis Q&A

**Does lodging the request pay anything?** No. The request is received for processing, and the credit stays on the account while the request is open.

**Which payment does a credit from contributions credited back to a quarter cite?** The last contribution payment received for that quarter.
